policy.scope: TextSnap Layout Windows x64 redistributable ZIP

status_definitions.verified: The exact artifact has verifiable package-license evidence and no known unresolved redistribution evidence in the current audit scope.
status_definitions.pending: Some license evidence or third-party native notice remains unresolved. The artifact may be used for development and testing but must not pass a redistributable release gate.
status_definitions.blocked: Redistribution evidence is absent or explicitly unacceptable. The artifact must not be included in a redistributable release.

notes: A successful download or package metadata license label alone is not sufficient to pass this gate.
The gate applies only to artifacts actually retained in the final ZIP, but an included dependency cannot be silently omitted from the lock.

release_obligations.reason: PaddleX requires aistudio-sdk>=0.3.5 unconditionally and imports it at module load. Version 0.3.8 has UNKNOWN license metadata, no license file, no source distribution and no verifiable publisher project URL.
release_obligations.resolution_required: Obtain publisher redistribution authorization or receive user approval to change and validate the dependency boundary. Until then, aistudio-sdk must not enter the final ZIP.

release_obligations.reason: The wheel bundles native libraries but has no complete unified third-party notice set.
release_obligations.resolution_required: Inventory retained DLLs and complete verifiable notices for MinGW libgcc/libgfortran/libquadmath, BLAS/LAPACK and every other retained native component.

release_obligations.reason: Both wheels carry only LicenseRef-Qt-Commercial.txt even though package metadata advertises an LGPL/GPL choice.
release_obligations.resolution_required: Choose and document an allowed Qt licensing path, inventory retained Qt DLLs/plugins, collect their third-party notices, and verify applicable LGPL distribution obligations.

release_obligations.reason: The artifacts contain multiple Microsoft runtime DLL versions, and Microsoft conditions redistribution on its license terms.
release_obligations.resolution_required: Verify the distributor has the required rights, retain the applicable terms, and select DLLs only after PE dependency and Windows loading validation. Never deduplicate solely by basename.

release_obligations.reason: The exact BOS archives contain no license. Official same-name model cards say Apache-2.0, but their model files are not byte-identical.
release_obligations.resolution_required: Obtain publisher evidence explicitly covering the locked BOS bytes or user-approved replacement artifacts with equally verified runtime behavior.

release_obligations.reason: These native Rust wheels carry their project license text but no complete inventory of statically linked crate notices.
release_obligations.resolution_required: Build a version-specific Cargo dependency and license inventory from publisher sources, then collect all notices required by retained native code.

release_obligations.reason: The abi3 wheel carries the protobuf license, but bundled or statically linked native dependency notices have not been independently inventoried.
release_obligations.resolution_required: Audit the publisher build inputs for this exact wheel and collect any required third-party notices.
